quality_guards: Biological-agent risk depends on agent classification, exposure route, concentration, task, containment, controls and worker susceptibility.
Compressed-air risk depends on pressure, equipment condition, controls, blockage, maintenance, task and operator competence.
Printing-chemical risk depends on product composition, process, task, ventilation, contact route, duration and controls.
Cholera risk depends on destination, outbreak activity, food and water exposure, hygiene, vaccination and traveller factors.
Polio risk depends on virus type, vaccination, travel, exposure route, surveillance, containment and host factors.
Rubella risk depends on vaccination, contact intensity, pregnancy, setting, symptoms, laboratory confirmation and timing.
Chickenpox risk depends on immunity, vaccination, contact intensity, pregnancy, age, immune status and timing.
Blind-cord risk depends on loop accessibility, fixing strength, cord length, child age, supervision and product condition.
Ship-fire risk depends on vessel type, size, layout, machinery, fuel, cargo, detection, suppression and crew readiness.
Maritime-fatigue risk depends on work-rest schedules, sleep quality, workload, voyage conditions, staffing, health and management controls.
